issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies that SealSaloon has an attribute orders as a modifiable List<Meal>, but the solution implements orders as an array (Meal[]). This creates a structural mismatch for students about which data structure to use for the FIFO order queue (List operations vs array + ArrayHelpers).
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts on a single representation: either (a) update the problem statement/UML to require Meal[] orders (and explicitly mention using ArrayHelpers), or (b) change the solution to use List<Meal> (e.g., ArrayList) for orders as stated.
